opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. N. D. Ga. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 389 U. S. 910.) Motion of appellee Willie Hester for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that Robert B. Thompson,. Esquire, of Gainesville, Georgia, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for appellee Willie Hester in this case.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
